title: How does ChatGPT help you write?

body.text: — articles, social posts, emails, reports, or video scripts. Just give it the topic, audience, and format you want, and you'll get a draft you can refine right away.

example: "Write a 500-word article on 'how to choose a laptop for students' in a casual tone, with 3 subheadings."

title: Edit and improve existing writing

body.text: Besides writing from scratch, ChatGPT can also
proofread and improve writing you already have
— adjust the tone, check grammar, or make it more concise. Just paste your original text and say what you want changed.

example: "Make this more formal and 30% more concise: [paste your original text]"

question: How can ChatGPT help with writing?

options.text: Writing new content, editing, and improving existing writing

question: When you want ChatGPT to edit your writing, what should you do?

options.text: Just say "make it better" with no details
Paste the original text and say what you want changed
Give only the title without attaching the text

question: What kinds of content can ChatGPT help write?

options.text: Articles, emails, social posts, scripts, and much more

question: You have a draft and want it shorter and more formal. How should you ask?

options.text: Paste the text and say "make it ~30% more concise and more formal"

question: What kind of writing is ChatGPT good for?

options.text: A wide range — emails, posts, scripts, and reports
